title: Observation-representation discriminator for the audited credential-free local multi-step Web-agent failure: does suppressing the hidden reveal affordance from ELEMENTS (and/or presenting an accessibility-tree observation) let a byte-verified local class clear the frozen bar, or is the failure capacity/credential-gated (blocker B3)?
question: On the byte-verified credential-free local models (M-14B-QWEN, M-8B-LLAMA) and the frozen minimal multi-step Web-agent protocol, does the audited failure mode - step-0 reveal succeeds and PAGE_TEXT contains the target, yet the model emits a hidden-button re-click loop with zero answer actions - resolve when the observation/action representation is the single varied factor (suppress the hidden reveal button from the ELEMENTS observation; and/or present a full accessibility-tree observation) so that representation failure is separated from raw multi-step control capacity; i.e. do either local class reach answer_action_emission_rate > 0 and task_success_rate >= 0.6, or does the failure persist across observation changes - in which case B3 is credential-gated and the exact human-issued credential/endpoint blocker is recorded instead of another ladder re-run?
hypothesis: H1 (representation, primary): the audited failure mode is caused by the observation representation, not by a hard multi-step control-capacity ceiling - specifically, the frozen observe() lists the now-hidden #reveal-btn in ELEMENTS after the reveal click, so the model re-clicks an affordance that is no longer actionable. Under an otherwise byte-identical protocol (same runner bytes + frozen patch, same fixture, P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, frozen GBNF, temperature=0.0, seeds 42-46, same strict parse_action and mechanical scorer, same GGUF bodies), a treatment observation that does not list the hidden affordance (VISIBLE) - and/or a full accessibility-tree observation (A11Y) - will let at least one tested credential-free class reach task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6, with answer_action_emission_rate > 0.
falsifier: H0 (bounded negative). Under EVERY treatment observation mode (VISIBLE, and A11Y where run), both tested credential-free classes reproduce the parent failure signature - answer_action_emission_rate == 0.0 AND task_success_rate == 0.0 AND step0_reveal_click_rate == 1.0 - while their in-run BASE cells reproduce the parent failure exactly; hence the audited failure mode is NOT an observation-representation defect and readiness condition (3) / blocker B3 is credential-gated (no factory-provisionable credential-free local endpoint clears the frozen minimal bar; the carried endpoint census already records 0 PROVISIONABLE_CREDENTIATED of 12 providers). FALSIFIES is asserted only over the COMPLETE, predeclared treatment cells at the two tested classes; it is a bounded capability/representation bound, not a global rejection of C-LLM-INHERIT and not a closure of hosted frontier classes. A cell whose GGUF fails byte-level content-identity verification, whose load fails, or whose positive-control gate fails is recorded UNMEASURED_* (operational) and is NOT counted as a capability failure; if no treatment cell is COMPLETE the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a scientific negative.

observation_modes.definition: The verbatim frozen observe(): page.eval_on_selector_all('button, a, input', 'els => els.map(...)') (visibility ignored) plus page.inner_text('body')[:300]. Byte-identical semantics to the frozen runner.

Same selector and same element record shape, but the map is replaced by a filter that drops elements with a zero-area bounding box or computed display:none / visibility:hidden / opacity:0. Suppresses the now-hidden #reveal-btn after the reveal click while still listing it before the click. page_text unchanged.

Locator('body').aria_snapshot() when available, else Page.accessibility.snapshot(interesting_only=True) flattened to {tag: role, id: '', text: name[:40]}; serialized into the same ELEMENTS slot. page_text unchanged. If neither API is present the mode raises an explicit operational RuntimeError -> UNMEASURED_OBS_MODE_UNAVAILABLE (never a capability failure). Confounds format with affordance and is therefore secondary/conditional.

early_stop_rule: As soon as any treatment cell (VISIBLE or A11Y) is COMPLETE and CLEARS the frozen bar, OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, B3_STATUS=SATISFIED and EXECUTE stops (no further cells, no further downloads). A BASE cell that CLEARS stops the run with OUTCOME=MIXED (reproduction anomaly, see decision rule rule 3).

baselines.description: The SAME tested classes under the verbatim frozen observation (SPIDER_OBS_MODE=base), run in the same session with identical model bytes, prompt, GBNF, sampling, seeds and scorer. This is the strongest fair baseline because the observation is the only varied factor and its step-1 parseable rate is already 1.0 with positive controls 10/10 (parent), so any treatment gain is attributable to the observation and not to decoding.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL, reproducing the parent: task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), answer_action_emission_rate=0.0, step0_reveal_click_rate=1.0. A BASE cell that CLEARS is a reproduction anomaly -> OUTCOME=MIXED, B3=UNRESOLVED.

members.protocol: 5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) driven through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer against the served page, with page.goto before every episode. The scripted step producer returns json.dumps strings as required by the frozen parse_action contract (observation-independent).
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full click-then-answer completion path and mechanical verification is live)
members.failure_policy: <5/5 -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer broken, not model behaviour).

members.protocol: Manipulation check driven against the REAL served page with a scripted reveal (no model). For each mode m in the modes to be run: navigate; observe under mode m before the reveal click; click #reveal-btn; observe again under mode m. Assert: (a) OBS-BASE post-reveal ELEMENTS still contains an entry with id == 'reveal-btn' (the audited defect is present); (b) OBS-VISIBLE pre-reveal ELEMENTS contains id == 'reveal-btn' (the step-0 affordance is still offered); (c) OBS-VISIBLE post-reveal ELEMENTS does NOT contain id == 'reveal-btn'; (d) OBS-A11Y post-reveal exposes no clickable control named 'Reveal'; (e) page_text contains 'TARGET-42' post-reveal in every mode.
members.success_criterion: all assertions (a)-(e) hold for the modes actually run; recorded per mode as hidden_affordance_listed_post_reveal and target_text_present_post_reveal
members.failure_policy: any assertion false -> the varied factor is not live as specified -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a capability result).

members.protocol: 10 probes per evaluated cell of the frozen probe string ('Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}') under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA with the frozen GBNF grammar (string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65), executed by the frozen runner mode_probe_candidate. Identical across observation modes (the probe does not read the observation).
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)
members.failure_policy: a cell whose PC gate fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes) and recorded UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED; it is not a capability failure.

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real frozen scorer against the SERVED task page (navigated).
null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID

measurement_validity: Frozen protocol identity: this packet reuses the audited frozen runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (file sha256 2b5d5bb5da608adbcc68cc78120a88bc2b8809816e29f9d87d25c0c75bc25c00) and the frozen base fixture research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/harness_config.json (file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb). Both are freeze_artifacts; EXECUTE must re-verify their hashes and fail closed on mismatch.

Single manipulated dimension: the observation mode (SPIDER_OBS_MODE) is the ONLY varied factor. The frozen runner is reconstructed by applying the frozen observation patch (Appendix A of prereg.md, embedded in the hashed prereg) to the frozen runner bytes; EXECUTE must verify (i) the reconstructed file sha256 == b2e3b7f9a1411176d66ba21f03659d9d21372fef5fa5b3ecad3ffd40dc7c0cd3, (ii) OBS_MODE default resolves to 'base', and (iii) under base the observe() body is AST-identical to the frozen observe() body. Mutation beyond the frozen patch region -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Substrate identity: frozen single-page MIN-WEBAGENT-CLICK-REVEAL-ANSWER fixture (#reveal-btn reveals #target=TARGET-42; the reveal button is hidden after the first click), max_steps_per_episode=5, threshold_target_text=TARGET-42; served on 127.0.0.1 via the frozen start_page_server, driven by Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome.

Candidate identity (fail-closed, non-substituting): each candidate is pinned to (i) sha256 of the FULLY DOWNLOADED served body, (ii) exact byte count, (iii) a repo-revision-pinned URL, (iv) an independent GGUF metadata fingerprint. IDENTITY-PASS requires bytes==pin AND sha256==pin AND fingerprint==pin; on mismatch one re-download is allowed, and a persistent mismatch is UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED with observed values recorded, never a substituted body.

Deterministic decoding: temperature=0.0, llama_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46, n_ctx=2048, max_tokens=512, n_threads=4; a per-cell PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING gate 10/10 must pass before episodes; the strict parse_action requires the entire completion to be valid JSON with the action-appropriate required field.

Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions plus whole-string JSON-schema parse identical to the frozen parse_action; task_success requires the mechanical reveal (#target visible with text TARGET-42) AND a terminal answer action whose text equals TARGET-42. No LLM grading.

The frozen bar (task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6 over 5 episodes) is unchanged from the parent and is a pre-declared capability-gate adequacy rule over deterministic episodes, not a statistical threshold; there is no variance estimate.

Per-cell config overlays are deterministic transformations of the frozen base config: only prompts.system (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA), sampling.chat_format (family chat format) and candidate_models_frozen are replaced. ALL OTHER keys, including the user_template and the task page, are inherited byte-for-byte; the overlay is written to <cell-outdir>/raw/harness_config.json and its object-level diff is confined to those three keys. The observation patch never edits the fixture.

A11Y mode is fail-closed and operational: if neither Locator.aria_snapshot nor Page.accessibility.snapshot exists in the installed Playwright build, the a11y cell is UNMEASURED_OBS_MODE_UNAVAILABLE (operational, not capability) and the primary VISIBLE-vs-BASE contrast is unaffected.
decision_rule: OUTCOME is exactly one of {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MIXED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}. B3_STATUS is a separate derived field in {SATISFIED, NOT_SATISFIED, UNRESOLVED}. DEFINITIONS: a CELL(m) is the frozen runner run for one treatment_arm cell_id at observation mode m = a PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING gate (10 probes) followed by an episode batch (clearing_threshold.episodes=5). CELL(m) is COMPLETE iff identity-PASS AND load_status==LOADED AND positive_control_pass_rate==1.0 AND exactly 5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff LOADED and the PC gate did not pass (no episodes); UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED iff identity verification failed or the model failed to load; UNMEASURED_OBS_MODE_UNAVAILABLE iff the observation mode could not be produced; PARTIAL iff the PC gate passed but fewer than 5 episode records. CLEARS(m) iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6. REPRO_OK(m_base) iff COMPLETE and NOT CLEARS and answer_action_emission_rate==0.0 and step0_reveal_click_rate==1.0. PARTIAL_SIGNAL(m) iff COMPLETE and not CLEARS and (answer_action_emission_rate>0 OR task_success_rate>base.task_success_rate). PRECEDENCE (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT, executed once: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE==5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION==(parseable_action_rate_step1 0.0, task_success_rate 0.0) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION==(parseable_action_rate_step1 1.0, task_success_rate<0.6) AND PC-OBSERVATION-CONTRAST passes for every mode that will be run AND all freeze_artifact hash checks match AND required stack imports succeed AND the reconstructed runner sha256 matches AND the base-mode observe AST-equivalence holds; else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP. (2) CANDIDATE IDENTITY+LOAD per model at first use: full-download byte verification + GGUF fingerprint; a persistent mismatch or a load failure is UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED (operational), the model is dropped and the run continues with the remaining model. (3) BASE REPRODUCTION: for each model, the BASE cell must be REPRO_OK. If any BASE cell CLEARS -> OUTCOME=MIXED, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP (the parent's deterministic 0/5 did not reproduce, so the observation factor cannot be cleanly identified for that model; recorded as a reproduction anomaly, not a capability result). If no BASE cell is COMPLETE -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP. (4) TREATMENT: run CELL-VISIBLE for each model whose BASE is COMPLETE and REPRO_OK, in the frozen order. If any CELL-VISIBLE CLEARS -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, B3_STATUS=SATISFIED, STOP. (5) A11Y (conditional): if no CELL-VISIBLE CLEARS, run CELL-A11Y for each model whose BASE is COMPLETE and REPRO_OK (only if the a11y API is available); if any CELL-A11Y CLEARS -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, B3_STATUS=SATISFIED, STOP; an a11y unavailability is UNMEASURED_OBS_MODE_UNAVAILABLE and is not a capability failure. (6) AFTER all planned cells (no CLEARS): let T = { treatment cells that are COMPLETE }. If T is empty -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP. Else if any t in T has PARTIAL_SIGNAL -> OUTCOME=MIXED, B3_STATUS=NOT_SATISFIED (the representation change is necessary-but-insufficient; the exact effect is recorded). Else (every t in T is COMPLETE, not CLEARS and not PARTIAL_SIGNAL, i.e. answer_action_emission_rate==0.0 and task_success_rate==0.0) -> OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, B3_STATUS=NOT_SATISFIED, and the exact carried per-provider credential/endpoint blocker is recorded in the result. An identity/load/PC/observation-mode failure is never encoded as a capability failure. Canonical packet mapping: SUPPORTS -> result.outcome=SUPPORTS, status=COMPLETE; FALSIFIES -> result.outcome=FALSIFIES, status=COMPLETE; MIXED -> result.outcome=MIXED, status=COMPLETE; MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> result.status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, result.outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. B3_STATUS, the reproduction signature and the manipulation-check records are written in result.metrics/observations.
product_consequence_positive: If a treatment cell CLEARS the bar (OUTCOME=SUPPORTS): the audited failure mode is an observation-representation defect, not a capacity ceiling, and readiness condition (3) / blocker B3 is satisfied with a factory-provisionable credential-free local endpoint (the clearing class + llama.cpp + the specified observation change). The gated four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) becomes executable at that class with the frozen protocol, subject to B1 (shipped carrier) and B2 (Runtime-owned non-ceiling dynamic-range task bank). It also supplies a concrete, measurable product requirement: the observation layer must suppress non-actionable/hidden affordances and/or emit an accessibility-first observation, because list-all-`button,a,input` observations induce action loops. Whether C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL remains a DIRECTOR adjudication.
product_consequence_negative: If no treatment cell CLEARS (OUTCOME=FALSIFIES or MIXED, B3_STATUS=NOT_SATISFIED): the audited failure mode is not repaired by the observation-representation change alone. FALSIFIES means the failure persists identically and readiness condition (3) is credential-gated: the recorded per-provider blocker becomes the decision input, and the program must obtain a human-issued hosted credential/model class or re-scope Gate 3 (drop the same-model external published-baseline anchor in favour of internally re-run comparators on a certified dynamic-range task bank). MIXED means the observation change is a necessary-but-insufficient component (behaviour changed, bar not cleared) and the next step is a combined representation+task-structure probe, not another identical ladder run. Either way the program stops spending cycles rediscovering the same absence, and no product mechanism is promoted from this packet.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4, 15 GB RAM / ~14 GB available, 85 GB free disk; /usr/bin/google-chrome 154.x present; llama_cpp and playwright NOT preinstalled -> EXECUTE installs llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 from PyPI sdist (present, verified at DESIGN) and playwright). Downloads (re-download-and-verify against the served-body pins; GGUFs live outside the repo at /tmp/opencode/gguf and are ephemeral): M-14B-QWEN 8,988,110,976 bytes + M-8B-LLAMA 4,920,739,232 bytes = ~13.9 GB worst case (early stop after the first CLEARS may avoid the second download). Inference: per cell 10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps; parent-measured CPU latency ~11 s/call for 14B and ~6 s/call for 8B gives ~6 min (14B) and ~4 min (8B) per cell; 4 unconditional cells + up to 2 conditional a11y cells ~= 40-70 min inference. Build llama-cpp-python ~5-15 min; playwright <5 min; preflight/controls <10 min. No external API spend. Wall-clock estimate 60-120 min.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions. Positive: the single binding blocker B3 is removed without any credential, the flagship four-arm benchmark unblocks, and the product gets a concrete observation-layer requirement. Negative (FALSIFIES): the failure is bounded as not-observation-repairable and credential/capacity-gated, the exact blocker is carried forward, and the Director gets an explicit re-scope set instead of another spent ladder. MIXED: the first direct evidence that representation is a necessary component and the exact next probe is specified. The experiment directly tests the parent handoff's declared unknown on whether the failure reflects intrinsic multi-step control capacity or the frozen simplified observation representation (carry_forward.unknown) and the mandate's PIVOT, and does NOT re-run the spent 3B-8B prompt ablation, the byte-identity ladder, or the hosted census.

forbidden_pin_sources: HF tree-API lfs.oid used WITHOUT a full-download confirmation
remote_artifact_pin_policy.revision_pinning: the frozen URL uses the repo commit sha resolved at DESIGN time (resolve/<revision_sha>/<file>); the served revision cannot move under the freeze even if 'main' advances
remote_artifact_pin_policy.design_time_verification: Both pinned URLs answered HTTP 200 at DESIGN with content-length equal to the pinned byte counts and x-linked-etag equal to the pinned served-body sha256 (HEAD only, no confirmatory download in this packet); the parent already full-download-verified both pins at EXECUTE (handoff.json#carry_forward.established).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every branch is arithmetically reachable and no later rule is shadowed. SUPPORTS requires one COMPLETE treatment cell with task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6 (k>=3/5); reachable because the frozen scorer registers the full click-then-answer completion (carried PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5) and the GBNF admits the success path (string grammar admits '#reveal-btn' and 'TARGET-42'), and because the treatment observation post-reveal still contains TARGET-42 in page_text (asserted by PC-OBSERVATION-CONTRAST), so the model has the information needed to answer. FALSIFIES requires at least one COMPLETE treatment cell with answer_action_emission_rate==0.0 and task_success_rate==0.0; reachable because the same classes already realized exactly this failure mode under the frozen observation (carried parent anchor) and the treatment may not change it. MIXED is reachable in two ways: any COMPLETE treatment cell with answer_action_emission_rate>0 (partial representation effect) or any BASE cell that CLEARS (reproduction anomaly, guarded so it cannot silently become SUPPORTS). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure, no COMPLETE base cell, or no COMPLETE treatment cell. Thresholds (5 episodes, k in 0..5) are attainable at both ends; the early-stop at rule 4 cannot shadow FALSIFIES because a non-clearing run continues and a clearing run has nothing left to falsify. Operational failures (identity/load/PC/a11y-unavailable) are explicitly non-terminal and cannot empty the FALSIFIES/MIXED branches.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified at DESIGN time or pinned fail-closed: (a) stack probe: Python 3.12.15, nproc=4, 15 GB RAM / ~14 GB available, 85 GB free disk, /usr/bin/google-chrome 154.0.8037.97 present; llama_cpp and playwright absent at DESIGN and installed at EXECUTE (same as parent); llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 sdist present on PyPI (verified) and registers both 'llama-3' and 'qwen' (carried parent DESIGN verification); (b) both revision-pinned GGUF URLs answered HTTP 200 with content-length equal to the pinned byte counts and x-linked-etag equal to the pinned served-body sha256; (c) the observation patch applies to the frozen runner with anchor count 1, py_compile passes, the reconstructed file sha256 is recorded, and every mode branch is reachable (non-outcome-bearing stub probe, Appendix B); (d) the a11y mode is fail-closed if its API is missing. No credential is required.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The comparator is an in-run BASE cell on the SAME model bytes under the SAME runner/fixture/prompt/grammar/sampling/seeds/scorer, with the observation mode as the only varied factor; the frozen runner patch is bound by (frozen runner sha256 + patch fragment sha256 + reconstructed runner sha256) and verified before any episode. The parent's carried result (0/5 both classes) defines the expected reproduction signature, and REPRO_OK (answer_action_emission_rate==0.0 AND task_success_rate==0.0 AND step0_reveal_click_rate==1.0) is required before a treatment cell may be attributed; a BASE cell that CLEARS forces OUTCOME=MIXED with B3=UNRESOLVED rather than being silently read as a treatment success. Baseline identifiability therefore does not rest on any stated model prior.

control_sensitivity.reason: PC-OBSERVATION-CONTRAST is a direct manipulation check on the real served page and is sensitive to the exact defect: in OBS-BASE the post-reveal ELEMENTS must still list #reveal-btn (defect present), in OBS-VISIBLE it must be absent post-reveal yet present pre-reveal, and page_text must contain TARGET-42 post-reveal in every mode. A DESIGN-time semantic probe of the exact two JS element sources on a synthetic element with display:none confirms the filter drops the hidden button post-reveal while keeping it pre-reveal (Appendix B); the same assertions are re-run on the real page at EXECUTE and a failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (0.0/0.0) and B-RANDOM-ACTION (parseable 1.0, success<0.6) are equally sensitive to a broken scorer, as the parent measured.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment is structurally executable and was exercised in a non-outcome-bearing stub probe: with the frozen runner patched (anchor count 1, py_compile OK) and heavy deps stubbed, SPIDER_OBS_MODE=visible and =a11y both dispatch to live branches that return a well-formed observation dict, the default resolves to 'base', the a11y mode falls back from Locator.aria_snapshot to Page.accessibility.snapshot and raises an explicit operational error when neither exists, and an unknown mode raises. The base branch is AST-identical to the frozen observe() body, so 'base' cannot silently become a treatment. No model, no browser and no outcome-bearing measurement was used.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: The interpretation depends on three mutable local files, all listed in freeze_artifacts and hashed by the freezer: the frozen runner (2b5d5bb5...), the frozen base fixture (7aba9dc8...), and the prompt-provenance file (4e2b6710...). The only new code is the observation patch, which is embedded verbatim in prereg.md (itself hashed into freeze.json.hashes) and identified by patch_old_fragment_sha256=183d3c630e661de298567bdd4062a3b3d7cbbd6d2dac345dd2ff6334f4b8d654, patch_new_fragment_sha256=61d8bf3fa5ec66f77e4157ab103535dc397eacf5e1c447fb5c3d5787ef235a66 and reconstructed_runner_sha256=b2e3b7f9a1411176d66ba21f03659d9d21372fef5fa5b3ecad3ffd40dc7c0cd3.
